_comment: OCHA lower third — SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the numbers (look B, approved 2026-07-12; SIZE raised 2026-08-20 to name 54px on a 1080-wide canvas). name_short_ratio multiplies the canvas SHORT SIDE, not its height: the strip is horizontal, so what governs how big it reads is the narrow dimension. The old per-orientation height ratios gave 4:5 a 31px name and 9:16 a 44px one on the same 1080 width - that inconsistency is what this replaced. Consumed by engine/lower_third.py (Titles & branding Full + statement clips) AND browser/engine.js (Lite mode). Change the look here once; drawing logic lives in those two files.

alt.label: Bebas Neue (UN videos)
alt._note: Second face offered in the panel's Advanced settings > Font. Google Bebas Neue (OFL) so the web app can bundle it too; single weight, so name and organisation share it. scale=1.4 because Bebas is a CONDENSED face: measured, its cap height is 0.99x Raleway's at the same size but its width is only 0.59x, which is what reads as 'too small'. 1.4 was checked against every band in all four formats - the ink still clears the box with 20-32px to spare, so no band geometry changes. Default stays Raleway.
